    The Withered
    FarmChoose your run

    The farm is ready for one player or a crew of up to four farmhands. Single-player keeps the full current run; online multiplayer opens co-op, free-for-all, and team deathmatch rooms.

    • W A S D Move
    • Mouse Look
    • Space Jump
    • Shift Sprint
    • Ctrl Crouch / slide while sprinting
    • W / S Climb ladders
    • Click Fire / punch
    • V Quick melee
    • RMB Aim — steadier, slower
    • 1–9 Switch weapon
    • R Reload
    • G Throw grenade
    • E Interact / use Barn Key / gates
    • Esc Free the mouse
    • F Flashlight lantern
    Left stick moves and runs; push up/down while on a ladder to climb. Drag anywhere on the right to look. Tap a weapon in the inventory strip to equip it. Hold Fire and drag to aim while shooting. Tap Throw to use a grenade once you find them, and Use for keys, doors, gates, and workbenches.

      SettingsSound, display, and controls

      Sound

      Voice Chat

      Party chat in Co-op, proximity mic in Deathmatch/Teams.

      Display

      Full Picture runs soft shadows, edge softening and 4x smoothing. Balanced keeps shadows at half the map size. Fast drops shadows entirely and keeps only the film grade — use it on older laptops.

      Weapon Pickups

      Only affects newly found normal weapons. Hero specials and scripted quest weapons still equip when required.

      Spray Torch Signature

      Stored only in this browser. Maximum source size 512 KB; images are resized to 256 × 256.

      Equip the Spray Torch and press V (or Melee on touch) near a wall or floor to tag it without using fuel.

        The LayoutSurface and basement, one coordinated grid
